## v0.1.28 — air-gap install correctness fix

### What this fixes

Customers who installed v0.1.27 via the air-gap **Install from file** path
saw the Updates page continue to show **"1 update available · v0.1.27"**
even after a successful install. Two root causes:

- **The MQTT ingest worker wasn't actually getting updated.** The catalog
  used the service name `mqtt-ingest` while the rest of the stack (Docker
  Compose, the api's target selector) calls it `ingest-worker`. The
  install-target diff joins by service name and silently skipped it. The
  fix renames the catalog entry to match.
- **Some images record an "image-id" digest after offline load** rather
  than the registry manifest digest. The Updates page compared the
  recorded digest against the catalog's manifest digest, found a
  mismatch, and reported an update as still pending. Fixed by having
  the post-install version recorder trust the just-installed bundle's
  catalog digest when the local image record is missing the registry
  origin info.

### Who should install this

Anyone who installed v0.1.27. Symptom is purely cosmetic — the rest of
the stack is healthy — but the false-positive warning is annoying.

### Upgrade path

Standard install through the Updates page. Use the same **Install from
file** card you used for v0.1.27. After install completes, the warning
will clear and the Updates page will read "Up to date · v0.1.28".
